On your 200th birthday, your family has to rent a stadium.
And halfway through the party, someone calls from the hospital.
Hold the photo. Generation eight just arrived.
Here's how. If each generation has its first child at 25, you meet your child at 25, your grandchild at 50, and your great-grandchild at 75.
By 200, you could meet eight generations of your descendants. That's nine generations with you in the photo.
Now imagine the chaos. Someone yells, Mum! And forty people turn around.
Your 175-year-old daughter still tells you to put a jacket on.
Then the baby arrives. You hold her, and she wraps her whole hand around your finger.
Your daughter leans over and says, I used to do that, didn't I?
